title: Analytics dashboard
blurb: A product analytics overview went from a stock shadcn dashboard of eight identical KPI cards and a four-series area chart to a release readout that answers one question in words: did last week's onboarding checklist move activation, and is the number final yet?

persona.name: Sam Okafor
persona.goal: Check on Monday whether last week's onboarding checklist moved activation, and see where the funnel still leaks, without exporting to a spreadsheet.

before.verdict: Clean, tidy and interchangeable with every shadcn starter. Eight identical cards each say "+x% from last month", Signups and New Signups repeat, MRR shows up again as Revenue, the chart stacks four unrelated series with no y-axis, and nothing tells Sam whether the checklist worked.

after.verdict: The page opens on a sentence, not a card grid: activation jumped to 41.8% the week the checklist shipped, 7.6 pts above an 11-week range drawn behind the line. The dashed tail and "Still counting" note say the cohort isn't final until Oct 27, the funnel shows which two steps moved, and stale Stripe data, an expired HubSpot token and a live event stream each say what they are and what to do.

critique.title: The page doesn't answer Sam's question
critique.detail: Activation is one of eight identical cards, shown as "+22.2% from last month" with no base. The chart has week labels but no y-axis and no marker for the checklist launch, so you can't connect the change to the number.

critique.title: Duplicate and invented metrics
critique.detail: Signups and New Signups show different numbers. MRR and Revenue both appear. "Total Users 24,812" and "Growth +24.5%" have no definition or comparison period.

critique.title: Chart palette encodes nothing
critique.detail: The default `--chart-1…5` orange, teal, navy and yellow are handed out by index: four unrelated series (Signups, Activated, Visitors, MRR on a different scale) share one area chart, and every funnel step gets its own color. Color is assignment order, not a signal for up, down or selected.

critique.title: Every number has the same weight
critique.detail: Every KPI is `text-2xl font-bold` with a 12px `text-muted-foreground` delta line, so a vanity total and the metric Sam cares about look identical. Figures are proportional, so columns of numbers jitter.

critique.title: Focus is removed and there are no states
critique.detail: The custom sidebar links set `outline: none` with only a hover background. The search box has a placeholder and no label, the trash button is an unlabeled icon, and there is no loading, empty or partial-data state, so a filter with no matches just shows a blank table.

critique.title: Identical cards, 32px row actions
critique.detail: Twelve `rounded-xl border` cards with the same padding and shadow give no grouping or priority, and each event row carries three 32px buttons (View, Edit, delete) below the 44px target size.

changes.before: Activation "+22.2% from last month" as one of 8 cards
changes.after: Release readout: "Activation jumped the week the checklist shipped, clear of its 11-week range." 41.8% vs. 33.1–34.2%, +7.6 pts
changes.why: Sam's Monday question gets a sentence with its proof under it, before any chart.

changes.before: Last week plotted like every other week
changes.after: Dashed provisional tail, hollow "41.8% so far" dot, "Still counting… Final read Mon, Oct 27" with a running mark
changes.why: Signups from the last 7 days can still activate. The chart says the number is partial instead of letting it be over-read.

changes.before: Four stacked area series in --chart-1…4, week labels, no y-axis
changes.after: Shaded band for the previous 11 weeks' range, "Checklist shipped" marker, metric switch, View as table
changes.why: The band is the baseline, so the jump reads against normal variation rather than one prior week.

changes.before: Funnel bars in a different chart color each
changes.after: "Where it moved": step conversion bars with an 11-week-average tick, +8.2 / +4.7 pts deltas, checklist tags, 291-account leak callout
changes.why: Shows which steps the checklist changed and where the next drop still is.

changes.after: Data sources with live / retrying / needs-you / synced marks; MRR KPI says "Stripe sync retrying · as of 06:10"; Reconnect HubSpot runs → done
changes.why: A number from stale data says so next to the number, and the fix is one click away.

changes.before: transition-colors on buttons only; numbers swap with no change shown
changes.after: clip-path draw-in 520ms, KPI values roll on range change, new events slide in every 6s; Pause queues them behind "Show 1 new event"
changes.why: Motion shows what changed and where. Pausing keeps rows from moving while Sam reads.

changes.before: 8 identical KPI cards incl. Signups + New Signups, MRR + Revenue
changes.after: 4 KPIs in one <dl>; Activation definition after a 500ms hover; W4 heatmap cells outlined as the source of the week-4 KPI
changes.why: Each number appears once and you can see where it comes from.

changes.after: 13px labels in --text-2, tabular-nums, JetBrains Mono for event names and properties
changes.why: Labels meet contrast, numbers line up, and event payloads read as code.

changes.before: .sidebar a { outline: none }; unlabeled search and trash icon; blank table on no match
changes.after: :focus-visible ring; "No events match" with Clear filter; dashed not-yet cohort cells
changes.why: Keyboard users can reach every control, and missing data looks deliberately missing.

changes.before: min-height: 100vh; 7-column events table scrolls sideways at 390px
changes.after: 100dvh shell with a sticky sidebar; tables scroll inside .table-scroll; no page scroll at 320px
changes.why: Sam checks this on a phone too.

tells: Tabs for Overview / Analytics / Reports / Notifications
Identical KPI cards with duplicate metrics
"+x% from last month" under every number
Four unrelated series on one area chart
Every widget in an identical rounded-xl card
Unlabeled icon buttons and placeholder-only search
outline: none on custom nav links
